sources.title: Evaluation of OpenAI Codex for HPC Parallel Programming Models Kernel Generation
sources.finding: Evaluates numerical kernels across Julia and other languages, including Julia GPU programming models.
sources.our_assessment: Supports testing numerical kernels separately from general code tasks. Old model results are not a modern frontier baseline. No task artifacts imported.

sources.finding: Separates correctness from timing and documents adversarial evaluation checks.
sources.our_assessment: Useful methodology, not a drop-in Julia/Mantle benchmark. Our four kernel tasks currently measure software-Vulkan functionality only, not speedup.

decisions: Finish frozen four-kernel development baseline and matched public-error repair comparison before expanding task count.
Keep numerical correctness, API compliance, atomic-safety advisories, hardware speed and rendered aesthetics as separate outcomes.
Select and register any future public Julia subset before model generation; qualify its references in the exact sandbox first.
Never use private assertions or reference outputs to select revisions or populate retrieval memory.
